title: Scheduled Product Changes at a Professional Email Reactivation Renewal
content:
Plan change rule for the product a suspended Professional Email subscription renews on when its reactivation renewal is paid. The renewal product is read from the scheduled product on the subscription, which is applied at the renewal that falls due on the term end date, and the plan seat price of the reactivation renewal is the renewal product's seat price.

| Scheduled product on the subscription | Upgrade line whose period end is the term end date in the current term | Renewal product |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter, Harborline Mail Plus, Microsoft 365 Business Basic or Microsoft 365 Business Standard | none | that scheduled product |
| any of those | present | the subscription's current product |
| none | — | the subscription's current product |

A move down never takes effect at the renewal that closes a term in which the subscription was moved up.

**Mailbox storage.** At a reactivation renewal a scheduled lower product is applied even where a mailbox does not fit the lower product's mailbox storage: such a mailbox is full and, where the product blocks sending from a full mailbox, stops sending until space is freed.

Examples (hypothetical subscriptions):
- a suspended Harborline Mail Pro subscription with Harborline Mail Plus scheduled and no upgrade line in the term renews on Harborline Mail Plus;
- a suspended Microsoft 365 Business Premium subscription that was moved up during the term, its upgrade line ending on the term end date, with Microsoft 365 Business Standard scheduled, renews on Microsoft 365 Business Premium;
- a subscription with no scheduled product renews on its current product.
